**No, the first wave can't start.** The preflight check didn't run because this session has no shell tool. I read the record against `references/autonomy-preflight.md` by hand, and it would fail on at least six points, two of which a rewrite of the record alone can't fix.

**What I found:** The preflight record for r1 is for a different night and doesn't match the plan. Its window is 2026-11-13 22:00Z to 2026-11-14 08:00Z, a week before tonight (2026-11-20), and the repository token `REPO_TOKEN` expired at 2026-11-14 03:00Z. The plan itself isn't marked as an unattended run, so the plan check that passed never tested it as one.

**Why it matters:** If it starts tonight as it stands, the run fails once it needs the repository (`REPO_TOKEN` already expired), and P1 and P2 log in to the same writable clerk account at the same time. Even if the work finished, the final gate would reject it with `PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED`, so nothing would reach the merge step.

**Do this first:**
1. Edit `.alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json`: set `execution.unattended: true` and give each package a `needs` list, including an `environment` need for `npm test` on P1 and P2. Then re-run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .` and note the `plan_digest` it prints.
2. Rewrite `.alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json`. It needs a `plan: {digest, base: "3f9c2e1"}` field, tonight's window, a token that lasts past 08:00, a second order-clerk account for P2, and `covers` on each entry. Re-run any probe whose subject changed.
3. Run `check_orchestration.py preflight .alchemy/runs/r1/preflight.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .`. Start only if it prints `PASS`.

**What I did not check:**
- The preflight checker itself, for the reason above. Step 3 closes it.
- The timezone. The record uses UTC (`Z`), and the lead's "22:00" may be local time. Confirm it with the lead before writing the window.
- Whether the decision list is complete. That needs each package's acceptance criteria read against the code, which is a judgment the checker can't make.

Agents:     3 (agent-a, agent-b, agent-c) of cap 2 concurrent, delegation depth 1

Reason:     P1 and P2 write disjoint sets with no dependency path; P3 is an independent reviewer
Plan check: reported PASS by the lead (not re-run here). The plan lacks execution.unattended,
            so the unattended rules (NEEDS_UNDECLARED) were never applied
Preflight:  Not run (no shell in this session). Manual reading predicts FAIL/STALE on:
  SCHEMA / PREFLIGHT_STALE  no `plan` {digest, base} binding
  NEEDS_UNDECLARED          P1, P2, P3 have no `needs`; P1 and P2 run command criteria with no environment need
  PREREQUISITE_UNCOVERED    no entry has `covers`
  CREDENTIAL_EXPIRES        A1 REPO_TOKEN expires 2026-11-14T03:00Z, before the recorded window end
                            and already past for tonight
  window                    2026-11-13T22:00Z–2026-11-14T08:00Z is not tonight; every expiry must
                            be re-checked against the new window
  ACCOUNT_CONFLICT          U1 "order clerk" (writable, no shared flag) serves P1 and P2, which run
                            together in wave 1
  probe mismatch            E4 probes "clerk-b auditor", but the record has no clerk-b account.
                            Either a second clerk was planned and dropped, or E4 tests the wrong identity
Holds:      evidence at base 3f9c2e1; baseline V1 `npm test` = E6 exit 0; escalation tested (E7);
            human steps only before the run or at the end; secrets named, no values;
            work I1 READY, I2 PARTLY-READY and reversible; decisions D1 answered, D2 default
